name: Render resolution 1280x720, output 1920x1080
description: Like render-720p.json, and the output buffers shrink from 3840x2160 to 1920x1080 as well, so the upscale, UI and final composition passes run at 1080p. Picture and HUD layout are unchanged. Frees about 0.8 GB of GPU memory. Use this one or render-720p.json, not both.
author: batatinhafcbatatinha-pixel
tested: KytyPS5 fork 5ff7b6da (local build, 2026-11-14), first gameplay scene, RTX 3050 laptop GPU: right picture, GPU memory 4.4 GB -> 3.6 GB, 49 fps against 46-47 fps with render-720p.json (inside the run-to-run variation of that day). Not run in AnyPS5.
